name: Anser
eyebrow: Made for Mac · A local-first email client
intro: Bring your inboxes together. Keep complete mail on your Mac.
intro2: Rules do the sorting. Your history stays within reach.
platform: Apple Silicon + Intel · macOS 12 or later
productLabel: The real interface. Try it yourself.
capInbox: Work and personal mail, one workspace.
capArchive: Complete original messages and attachments, kept locally.
capRules: Set a rule once. Leave repetitive filing to Anser.
capCompose: Rich text, attachments, signatures and send preview, together.
sample: All interface images use fictional test data.
archiveBody: Choose complete local saving per account. Original messages and their attachments are kept independently. Once fully saved, they stay readable after server cleanup, even offline.
originalBody: Keep original MIME and embedded attachments, with integrity checks.
offlineBody: Fully saved mail does not depend on the server keeping its copy.
backupBody: Back up your archive and filing metadata. Take your history with you.
archiveNote: Complete saving must finish first. External images and linked files are not downloaded attachments.
rulesTitle: Let mail find its own place.
rulesBody: Projects, invoices, subscriptions. Combine subject, sender and attachment conditions. Preview your rules before applying them to historical mail.
importBody: Import EML, EMLX, Outlook MSG and MBOX locally. Keep original files and process imports in the background. A new client need not mean leaving your history behind.
importFoot: MBOX includes .mbx. Some MSG variants and mboxcl/cl2 are unsupported; see the guide.
more1Body: Unified viewing with clear account identities. IMAP / POP3 + SMTP support.
more2Body: Local full-text search with account, date, star and attachment filters.
more3Body: Translations below original paragraphs. Choose an OpenAI-compatible service or a local model.
more4Body: Autosaved drafts, send preview, an 8-second pre-send cancellation window, and local scheduled sending.
filmTitle: How a conversation becomes yours to keep.
filmBody: See receiving, filing and archiving become one considered workflow.
videoFallback: Video playback is unavailable. Download the film instead.
getTitle: A lasting home for important mail.
getBody: Free for personal use, including your own work email.
copyFailed: Clipboard unavailable. Select the command to copy it.
installNote: Currently Alpha. Project self-signed, without Apple notarization. First launch may require confirmation in macOS Privacy & Security.
footerPrivacy: Credentials stay in macOS Keychain. Mail and archiving need no Anser cloud. When you request translation, visible body text goes to your configured model service.
licenseNote: Source available · Free for personal use · Organizational deployment, commercial integration or resale requires separate permission.

archiveAlt: Anser local archive with fictional data
rulesAlt: Anser mail rules with fictional data
